status: RC — rc12 fixes two live issues on top of rc11. (1) Mid-scroll gate fallback: when a page navigates to /sorry/ mid-scroll the scrollBy script aborts, which previously exited the scroll loop before the gating re-check ran, so the window stayed on the CAPTCHA; now a scrollBy error triggers serveSnapshotIfGated immediately, and the re-check cadence is faster (every 200 iterations). (2) Seed loads more images before capture: scroll further in smaller steps with longer waits, then return to the top, so snapshots no longer have large blank areas where lazy thumbnails had not loaded.
